item.title: DappLooker: A Remarkable Year in Review
item.content:encoded:
# DappLooker: A Remarkable Year in Review ### 📈 2024 was the best year in terms of growth. DappLooker made significant strides in 2024, cementing its position as a leader in Web3 data analytics. Here's a snapshot of our growth: > Revenue: 7 figure (3x increase)
> Total Chains: 25+ (3x)
> Protocols Onboarded: 1000+
> Total Analysis: 10000+(4x)
> Queries Executed: 10M+ ## 🧙🏻‍♂️ [Introducing Loky: Your AI-Powered Analyst](https://x.com/0x_Loky?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) ![0xLoky](https://d2yxqfr8upg55w.cloudfront.net/ghost-media/2025/01/image.png) This year, we proudly launched [Loky](https://0xloky.com/?ref=blog.dapplooker.com), our AI agent designed to deliver sharp market insights and real-time crypto analysis. Loky has transformed how users interact with complex blockchain data, making insights more accessible and actionable. ## 🗺️ The Ecosystem Map for 2024 ![DappLooker Ecosystem Map 2024](https://d2yxqfr8upg55w.cloudfront.net/ghost-media/2025/01/image-1.png) We unveiled our comprehensive **Ecosystem Map for 2024**, showcasing our expanded reach and the tools empowering users to explore blockchain data seamlessly. ## 🤝 Partnerships and Collaborations ### [Expanding Into the Arbitrum Ecosystem](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1851255680407388505?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) We officially joined the Arbitrum ecosystem, simplifying data access for Arbitrum One and Orbit chains. ### [Cross-Chain Validation](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1841844469366456511?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Collaborating with Crossfi chain, we strengthened network security and decentralization as a trusted validator. ### [Award from Stellar Community Fund](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1783850739233865788?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) We were honored by the Stellar Community Fund to build innovative tools on the Stellar Network. ### [Integration with Manta Network](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1790351445277175872?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Manta Network users can now effortlessly analyze and build dashboards with our no-code solutions. ### [Partnering with HAQQ Network](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1825548919469928781?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Our partnership with HAQQ Network enhanced blockchain literacy and transparency. Users can now access custom dashboards to analyze smart contracts and track grant milestones. ### [Collaboration with EigenLayer](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1788568444780397041?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) We integrated with EigenLayer, empowering users to explore its ecosystem more effectively. ### [BitsCrunch](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1795540198161551841?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) and [Tenderize](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1763252072991133900?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Partnerships As a node operator for BitsCrunch, we ensured robust analytics capabilities. Additionally, our collaboration with Tenderize provided in-depth staking performance insights. ### [Integration with Bitte Protocol](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1799116120336863377?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Creators using Bitte Protocol now have access to powerful analytics and visualization tools. ### [Vara Network Validator Partnership](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1833508397863604642?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) We proudly announced our partnership with Vara Network, strengthening our validator presence. ## 🔍 Innovative Products and Features Launches ### [DataBots](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1763585445240463656?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Our custom DataBots allow communities on Discord and Telegram to retrieve blockchain data effortlessly. ### [AI Studio](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1848718482042720682?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) AI Studio simplifies querying blockchain data using natural language, making analytics more intuitive. ### [Subgraph Analyzer](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1816852194391724459?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) This dedicated tool helps users analyze and visualize subgraph data seamlessly. ### [Unified Explorer](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1844055686327758906?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Explore top Web3 protocols like The Graph, Celo, Vara, and Peaq Network all in one platform. ### [Chart as an Image API](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1805580348279181492?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Easily integrate charts into your applications with our image API. ## ✨ Highlights from Web3 & Crypto Events Our team attended and hosted key events across the globe, - [Devcon Bangkok:](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1763252072991133900?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Exclusive brunch with Web3 leaders. ![Modern Photo Collage](https://d2yxqfr8upg55w.cloudfront.net/ghost-media/2025/01/Modern-Photo-Collage---4-.png) - [EthCC Brussels:](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1815383831522017650?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Hosted the DataCon Happy Hour in collaboration with ZettaBlock. ![image](https://d2yxqfr8upg55w.cloudfront.net/ghost-media/2025/01/image-2.png) - [TechWeek New York:](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1801677211432587472?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Organized a VC & Founders Coffee Meetup. ![image](https://d2yxqfr8upg55w.cloudfront.net/ghost-media/2025/01/image-3.png) - [Consensus Austin:](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1801289144309776798?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Networked with blockchain pioneers. - [EthDenver:](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1766182566690971723?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Showcased our latest innovations. - **Token2049 Singapore:** Engaged with global crypto enthusiasts. ## 🎙️ Spaces and Workshops ### [DataWeek Masterclass](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1817190590901367264?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) We conducted a hands-on workshop to master on-chain analysis, empowering our community with new skills. ### [IIT Bombay Talk](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1844702016167420070?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) ![IIT Bombay Talk](https://d2yxqfr8upg55w.cloudfront.net/ghost-media/2025/01/1.png) Our founder Abhay shared insights during the Graph on Campus session hosted by The Graph India. ### [X Spaces on Blockchain Development](https://x.com/TheGraphIndia/status/1858535432335880571?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Collaborated with The Graph to discuss strategies for becoming a top 1% blockchain developer. ### [XXIM Podcast](https://x.com/dapplooker/status/1817190590901367264?ref=blog.dapplooker.com) Our co-founder Abhay joined XXIM podcast hosted by Ankit Sehgal, shared about DappLooker journey and vision. ## Looking Ahead to 2025 We are grateful for your unwavering support throughout 2024. Together, we achieved remarkable milestones. Let's aim even higher in 2025 and continue to redefine blockchain data analytics. 👏 **Thank you for being part of our journey!** # About DappLooker We help you effortlessly turn your data into revenue. DappLooker is a No-Code Web3 Business Intelligence & Analytics Hub that offers a suite of user-friendly tools for your business. Our suite includes Smart contract analytics, Subgraph analytics, DataBOTs, API SDK, and an AI Studio all designed for simplicity. Access analytics across 20+ networks, 1000+ Dapps, and analyze data from over 500M+ on-chain users. Let us empower you to make data-driven decisions.
